description: This file contains utility methods for handling binary data, CRC32 checksum calculations, byte order swapping, and packet construction related to the BinaryProtocol, used in the com.rusefi.binaryprotocol package.

classes.name: IoHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for CRC32 checksum calculation, byte order manipulation, and packet creation within the binary protocol communication.

methods.name: getCrc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a byte array, with optional offset and length.

methods.name: makeCrc32Packet
methods.description: Creates a packet with CRC32 checksum appended, including size headers.

methods.name: checkResponseCode
methods.description: Checks if the response packet has the expected response code.
